dual.convention: Raw A z>=b; E z=h; y>=0, eta free; r=c-A^T y-E^T eta>=0.

recovery.support_policy: All strictly positive returned values, not a new model restriction.
recovery.method: Exact symbolic linear algebra on one returned support; no optimizer.

scope_boundary: Exact necessary-cone optimality. The primal is not a complete ordered pure SPE realization; source validity is separately pinned and reviewed. The original six-player half problem remains OPEN unless separately proved.
